test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 11 Oct 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: According to the NREGA 'At a Glance' report, the average MGNREGA wages paid in the financial year 2021-2022 remain at only Rs. 208.85 per day. What is the full form of MGNREGA?

options.text: Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Activity
Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employer Guarantee Action
Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employee Guarantee Act
Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Act

solution:
The correct answer is __**Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Act**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Act (MGNREGA) was enacted in 2005 by the Indian Parliament.
 
• MGNREGA aims to enhance livelihood security in rural areas by providing at least 100 days of wage employment in a financial year to every household whose adult members volunteer to do unskilled manual work.
 
• The scheme covers all districts in India except those that have a 100% urban population.
 
• MGNREGA is demand-driven, meaning that employment is provided based on the demand for work by the rural populace.
 
• The wage payments under MGNREGA are made through direct bank transfers to the beneficiaries to ensure transparency and minimize corruption.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Objectives of MGNREGA:**

 
 
• To provide a social safety net for vulnerable groups by guaranteeing wage employment opportunities.
 
• To create durable assets that can improve rural infrastructure and enhance the overall quality of life.
 
• To strengthen the rural economy by providing employment and increasing the purchasing power of rural households.
 
 
 
• **Implementation Mechanism:**
 
 
• The Ministry of Rural Development (MoRD) is the nodal agency for the implementation of MGNREGA at the national level.
 
• At the state level, the State Rural Development Department oversees the implementation, while at the district level, it is managed by the District Programme Coordinator (DPC).
 
• Gram Panchayats play a crucial role in the planning and execution of the works under MGNREGA.
 
 
 
• **Funding Pattern:**
 
 
• MGNREGA is a centrally sponsored scheme with the central government bearing the full cost of wages and a significant portion of the material cost.
 
• The state governments are responsible for a part of the material cost and administrative expenses.
 
 
 
• **Monitoring and Evaluation:**
 
 
• Various monitoring mechanisms, including social audits, are put in place to ensure transparency and accountability in the implementation of MGNREGA.
 
• Regular evaluations and third-party assessments are conducted to assess the impact and effectiveness of the scheme.
